elevate.move: Make the photos the readings: clip the hero photo inside the clear-coat layer of the strata as a mask so the paint film is the photo, carry the same frame into the story with a gloss filter step per reading tied to --sw-p, and grade all three frames to one Clear-Coat Blue duotone so they read as one shoot.

One voice for numbers, one for words: Martian Mono only for numerals and units (4.4 mils, $350-$700, 41 dents); every eyebrow, label and Sample tag moves to Public Sans 13-14px sentence case or small caps, so the readings are the only mono on the page and the middle-dot eyebrow tell disappears.
